description: Development tooling for the Herdr Obsidian vault mods. Not part of either mod: never copy this file into a mod folder.
//: --test-timeout applies to each test file as a whole as well as to each test: tests/install.test.mjs runs the installers in Windows PowerShell and pwsh, which takes about 40 s on a Windows runner and more when the runner is busy, so a file gets 180 s. A test that hangs still fails, after at most 180 s.
